decisions.reason: It already has a public customer-value success claim, fits the core modular recycling offer, and management will see the 2023 launch investment as worth backing further rather than reversing quickly.

As a close extension of the established mobile equipment range with its own product page, it is easy to justify keeping while early market uptake is still assessed and launch costs are still being defended.

Because it is a flagship multi-model line tied to the firm's stated strategic direction toward modular cleaner machine generations, management is especially likely to persist with it despite any early uncertainty.

Although it shows less visible proof of market traction than A and less strategic prominence than C, it remains close to the core offer and a recent launch that management can plausibly treat as still in its ramp-up phase.
